description: This file implements the server-side logic for a login page in an online examination system. It handles user authentication for students and teachers, including database verification for students and hardcoded credentials for teachers.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for the login page, handling user login logic and navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler for page load, currently empty.

methods.name: signupB
methods.description: Handles the signup button click event, redirects users to the sign-up page.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles user login attempts, verifies credentials for students via database and for teachers via hardcoded check, then redirects accordingly.
